lines.en: label norikodorm20:
I knock on Noriko’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Noriko 的门，等着她来应门。

lines.en: And, now that she’s managed to get her completely unnecessary apology out of the way, I expect tonight to be mostly drama-free.
lines.zh: 既然她已经把那通完全没必要的道歉说完了，我预计今晚大体上不会再有什么波澜。

lines.en: Or at least that would have been the case before I thought of that.
lines.zh: 或者说，在我没有想到那件事之前本该如此。

lines.en: Now, I worry that I may have jinxed myself.
lines.zh: 现在，我担心自己可能乌鸦嘴了。

lines.en: Oh well. Worse comes to worst, I just let her waste her breath and apologize for something {i}else{/i} she doesn’t have to apologize for when it’s all said and done.
lines.zh: 算了。最坏的情况，也不过是让她白费口舌，等一切结束之后再为{i}另一{/i}件她根本不必道歉的事道歉而已。

lines.en: I’ll truly never stop being thankful for how predictable most [teenager]s are-
lines.zh: 我大概永远都会感谢[teenager]们的可预测性——

lines.en: And how even the slightest whiff of love can cause their brains to go haywire.
lines.zh: 以及哪怕只是一丝爱情的气味，就能让她们的大脑彻底失控这一点。

lines.en: : Noriko, are you in there?
lines.zh: : Noriko，你在里面吗？

lines.en: : Oh, Sensei! Yeah! I didn’t hear the first knock.
lines.zh: : 啊，老师！在！我没听见第一下敲门。

lines.en: : You can come on in.
lines.zh: : 你进来吧。

lines.en: scene black
I make my way into Noriko’s room to be assaulted by the same fruity scent of energy drinks that I’ve grown used to when visiting her and Kirin.
lines.zh: 我走进 Noriko 的房间，一如既往地被那股我已经习惯了的、属于她和 Kirin 的能量饮料的果味冲了个正着。

lines.en: Today’s scent is particularly potent, however. And if there’s anything I know about energy drinks-
lines.zh: 不过今天这股味道格外冲。而要说我对能量饮料有什么了解——

lines.en: It’s that Noriko will be exactly the same as always because the “energy” aspect is a myth perpetuated by big beverage companies to trick [teens] into buying products that will-
lines.zh: 那就是 Noriko 绝对会和平时一模一样，因为所谓的“能量”不过是个被大型饮料公司编出来的神话，专门用来骗[teens]去买那些——

lines.en: help them cope with the extreme mental strain of [high_school] life and its accompanying exhaustion before ultimately becoming addicted and drinking them until their kidneys are filled with stones.
lines.zh: 能帮他们应付[high_school]生活带来的极端精神压力和随之而来的疲惫的产品，直到最后上瘾，喝到肾脏里长满结石。

lines.en: Just kidding.
lines.zh: 开玩笑的。

lines.en: I’ve never had an energy drink.
lines.zh: 我从来没喝过能量饮料。

lines.en: I’m sure they’re okay.
lines.zh: 我相信它们没什么问题。

lines.en: scene norikochinadress1
: Oh, wow.
lines.zh: : 哦，哇。

lines.en: : Good wow or bad wow? What kind of wow is that?
lines.zh: : 好的哇还是坏的哇？这是哪种哇？

lines.en: : Just...can’t say I was expecting this.
lines.zh: : 只是……没想到会看到这个。

lines.en: : How does it look? Be honest. I can take it.
lines.zh: : 看起来怎么样？说实话。我受得住。

lines.en: : It looks...great. I’m just confused about why you’re wearing it.
lines.zh: : 看起来……很棒。我只是不明白你为什么穿着它。

lines.en: scene norikochinadress2
: My parents sent it to me.
lines.zh: : 我爸妈寄给我的。

lines.en: : They just redid the decor of the restaurant and they’re trying out new qipao to fit the color scheme. And of course Nee-chan is too busy to model for them anymore, so...voila.
lines.zh: : 他们刚把餐厅重新装修了一遍，正在试新的旗袍来配色调。当然姐姐现在忙得不可能再给他们当模特了，所以……当当。

lines.en: : Fancy Noriko.
lines.zh: : 讲究的 Noriko。

lines.en: : I like fancy Noriko. It doesn’t hurt my eyes trying to keep up with the outfit.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢讲究的 Noriko。至少我的眼睛不用费劲地去跟上你这身行头。

lines.en: scene norikochinadress3
: Hey! There wouldn’t be a need for me to dress the way I do if it weren’t for the necessity to fight back against societal expectations and the inherent Japanese obsession with professionalism!
lines.zh: : 嘿！要不是为了反抗社会期待，还有日本人骨子里对“专业感”的执念，我才用不着穿成平时那样！

lines.en: : Dressing in stuff that’s overcomplicated or hard to follow is just one of many ways I push back against what people expect of me! I’m fighting the power!
lines.zh: : 穿那些过于复杂、让人看不懂的衣服，只是我用来反抗别人对我期望的众多方式之一！我在对抗强权！

lines.en: : Right. And what are the {i}other{/i} ways you fight back against society’s expectations of you?
lines.zh: : 行吧。那你{i}还有{/i}哪些对抗社会期待的方式？

lines.en: scene norikochinadress4
: I pierced my belly button. Does that count?
lines.zh: : 我穿了肚脐环。这算吗？

lines.en: : What? No. And since when? I saw you in a swimsuit very recently and I do not remember that at all.
lines.zh: : 什么？不算。而且什么时候的事？我不久前才看你穿过泳衣，我可完全不记得有这东西。

lines.en: : My parents made me take it out because it got infected.
lines.zh: : 我爸妈让它发炎了，就逼我取下来了。

lines.en: : You truly are one of the great rebels of this generation, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你还真是这一代最伟大的反叛者之一啊。

lines.en: scene norikochinadress5
: I know that I’m not {i}actually{/i} rebelling in any way. But, to be fair, what could someone my age even do?
lines.zh: : 我知道我{i}其实{/i}根本没在反叛什么。不过说句公道话，我这个年纪的人又能做什么呢？

lines.en: : The best chance I’d have is starting a band and just hitting it big like that. But even then, there are a gajillion others trying to do the same thing.
lines.zh: : 我最好的机会也就是组个乐队然后就这么一炮而红。但即便如此，还有一亿个其他人在做同样的事。

lines.en: : Teenagers don’t really have a voice, Sensei. {i}Especially{/i} [teenage]girls.
lines.zh: : [teenage]人是没有话语权的，老师。{i}尤其是{/i}[teenage]女孩。

lines.en: : Hey, I’m not trying to tear you down. I’m just saying that it wouldn’t kill you to look a little more...normal from time to time.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我又不是在打击你。我只是说，你偶尔穿得……正常一点也不会要你的命。

lines.en: scene norikochinadress6
: Normal like this? Because I feel like I’d get a lot more stares going out in a qipao than I would in a brightly colored flannel with...chains and stuff.
lines.zh: : 像这样正常吗？因为我觉得穿着旗袍出门，绝对比穿着色彩鲜艳的法兰绒配……链条什么的更能吸引目光。

lines.en: : Besides, being {i}pretty{/i} is kind of Nee-chan’s thing now.
lines.zh: : 再说，{i}漂亮{/i}这种事现在已经是姐姐的专属了。

lines.en: : There’s no way I was ever going to be able to seriously compete with her once she started trying, so I just...wound up going a different route.
lines.zh: : 她一旦认真起来，我是怎么都不可能跟她正经竞争的，所以我才……走到了另一条路上。

lines.en: scene norikochinadress7
: I thought that route would be to your liking, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我还以为那条路会合你的意呢，老师。

lines.en: : A brand new Noriko would mean a brand new start to our relationship, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 一个全新的 Noriko 就意味着我们关系的全新开始，不是吗？

lines.en: : Just changing your clothes doesn’t change the person you are. And even if it did, you’d be brand new to me anyway.
lines.zh: : 换个衣服并不会改变你这个人。就算会，你对我来说也已经是个全新的人了。

lines.en: : Those memories are still in there somewhere. All the parts of the me in the past that you'd want to hang onto are still there.
lines.zh: : 那些记忆还留在里面的某个地方。过去那个我身上、你想留住的部分，全都还在。

lines.en: : There are just a lot of other parts that come included now as well.
lines.zh: : 只是现在又多了很多其他的部分。

lines.en: scene norikochinadress8
: And some {i}other{/i} parts that have been improved in a number of ways. But I’m sure I don’t need to remind you of those.
lines.zh: : 还有些部分在很多方面都升级了。不过我想我不用提醒你那些吧。

lines.en: : You certainly do not. In fact, I have a picture message saved in my phone to back that claim up.
lines.zh: : 你确实不用。事实上，我手机里还存着一张照片能证明这一点。

lines.en: scene norikochinadress9
: Sure wish I had something similar in {i}my{/i} phone.
lines.zh: : 真希望{i}我{/i}手机里也有类似的东西。

lines.en: : I can’t send you a picture of my penis, Noriko. That would be putting way too much power in the palm of your hand.
lines.zh: : 我不能给你发我阴茎的照片，Noriko。那等于把太大的权力交到你手心里了。

lines.en: scene norikochinadress10
: I wouldn’t do anything with it, I swear!
lines.zh: : 我不会拿它干什么的，我发誓！

lines.en: : Well...nothing involving anyone else! It would be for personal use only!
lines.zh: : 好吧……不外传！只供个人使用！

lines.en: : No can do. I’ll gladly accept any other photo you want to send me, though.
lines.zh: : 不行。不过你想发别的什么照片给我，我都很乐意收。

lines.en: scene norikochinadress11
: Mmm...meanie.
lines.zh: : 嗯……小气鬼。

lines.en: : Like...I don’t know. Maybe one in some sort of...Chinese dress?
lines.zh: : 比如……我不知道。也许是某张穿着……中式裙装的？

lines.en: scene norikochinadress12
: If you wanna see more of this, why not come to my parents’ restaurant with me sometime?
lines.zh: : 如果你想看更多这样子，要不要哪天跟我一起去我爸妈的餐厅？

lines.en: : They’d be really happy to see you {i}and{/i} you’d get to see me serve people in this thing.
lines.zh: : 他们见到你一定会很高兴，你{i}也{/i}能看到我穿着这身招待客人。

lines.en: scene norikochinadress13
: And who knows? Maybe I could {i}serve{/i} you too?
lines.zh: : 而且谁知道呢？也许我也能{i}招待招待{/i}你？

lines.en: : Bold claim for someone who has only dry humped me so far.
lines.zh: : 对一个目前为止只跟我干蹭过的人来说，口气挺大。

lines.en: scene norikochinadress14
: Ah~ The best dry humping of my life, too...
lines.zh: : 啊~ 而且是我这辈子最棒的一次干蹭……

lines.en: : ...How many people have you done that with?
lines.zh: : ……你和多少人做过这种事？

lines.en: scene norikochinadress15
: People? Just you. But then there’s stuff like pillows and...blankets if you curl ‘em up just right...and the corner of your desk...
lines.zh: : 人？只有你。不过还有枕头之类……要是卷得够好，毯子也行……还有你桌子那个角……

lines.en: : Excuse me?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : What? It smelled like you and there was no one else in the classroom.
lines.zh: : 什么啊？它闻起来像你，而且当时教室里没有别人。

lines.en: : I’m a growing girl. I get urges.
lines.zh: : 我正是长身体的年纪。我会有冲动。

lines.en: : Those urges just happen to be exponentially greater around things that you have touched.
lines.zh: : 只是在你碰过的东西旁边，那种冲动会成倍地膨胀。

lines.en: : If that were true you’d have already fucked Kirin by now.
lines.zh: : 要是真的，你早就把 Kirin 给操了。

lines.en: scene norikochinadress16
: Hey...come on.
lines.zh: : 嘿……别这样。

lines.en: : I obviously know that things have happened between you two, but you don’t need to remind me about it like that. That’s just mean.
lines.zh: : 我当然知道你们俩之间发生过什么，但你没必要用那种方式提醒我。太过分了。

lines.en: : I was just kidding. I didn’t mean anything by it.
lines.zh: : 我只是开个玩笑。没有别的意思。

lines.en: : You don’t have to apologize or anything, just...try not to bring other girls up if you don’t have to.
lines.zh: : 你不用道歉什么的，只是……如果不是非提不可，就别提别的女孩。

lines.en: scene norikochinadress17
: Uhh...A-Anyway! Why don’t we sit down and go back to talking about...my parents or something?! That should stave away the horny for a little while longer, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 呃……总、总之！我们为什么不坐下来，回去聊……我爸妈什么的呢？！那样应该能把那股色心再压一会儿，你觉得呢？

lines.en: : The last time we tried that, I’m pretty sure you imagined me fucking your dad.
lines.zh: : 上次我们试过这个，我很确定你最后想象的是我操你爸。

lines.en: scene norikochinadress18
: Ewwww, Dad! No! That’s {i}my{/i} boyfriend!
lines.zh: : 咦——，爸爸！不要！那是{i}我的{/i}男朋友！

lines.en: : And apparently you are already doing it again...
lines.zh: : 而且你显然又在做同样的事了……

lines.en: scene black
It takes Noriko a minute or two to stop fantasizing about a thing I really wish she wouldn’t fantasize about.
lines.zh: Noriko 花了一两分钟才停止幻想那件我真心希望她别去幻想的事。

lines.en: But after that, we manage to steer clear of “the horny” and move both locations and topics into territory we’re a bit more comfortable with.
lines.zh: 但在那之后，我们总算绕开了“那股色心”，把地点和话题都转移到了我们更自在的领域。

lines.en: Well, territory {i}she{/i} is more comfortable with.
lines.zh: 好吧，是{i}她{/i}更自在的领域。

lines.en: To be honest, if she came out right now and asked me to do what I refused to do to her outside of the Halloween party, I wouldn’t have a second thought.
lines.zh: 说实话，如果她现在开口要我做那件万圣节派对那晚我在外面拒绝做的事，我不会有半点犹豫。

lines.en: My hand would be buried deep inside of that sleek, Chinese dress...doing the same things to her I did to her sister in that fancy hotel room.
lines.zh: 我的手会深深埋进那条光滑的中式裙子里……对她做那些我在那间高级酒店房间里对她姐姐做过的事。

lines.en: I wonder if they’re just as similar on the inside as they are on the outside.
lines.zh: 我好奇她们里面是不是也和外边一样相似。

lines.en: I wonder how long it will take for me to find out.
lines.zh: 我好奇我要多久才能弄清楚。

lines.en: I wonder-
lines.zh: 我好奇——

lines.en: scene lavendersgreen1
scene lavendersgreen13
scene lavendersgreen18
scene lavendersgreen23
scene lavendersgreen29
scene lavendersgreen30
scene norikochinadress19
I don’t wonder anything.
lines.zh: 我什么也不好奇。

lines.en: I stop thinking because I have to stop thinking.
lines.zh: 我停止思考，因为我必须停止思考。

lines.en: Thinking more will be bad.
lines.zh: 再想下去会出事。

lines.en: Noriko loves me.
lines.zh: Noriko 爱我。

lines.en: Noriko won’t mind if I-
lines.zh: Noriko 不会介意我——

lines.en: : You’re being weird again.
lines.zh: : 你又变奇怪了。

lines.en: scene norikochinadress20
: Like when we walked home from[school].
lines.zh: : 就像我们从[school]走回家那次。

lines.en: : You’ve done it a few times before that too.
lines.zh: : 在那之前你也这样过好几次。

lines.en: : There are these like, long stretches of time where you’ll be there and you’ll be responding, but it won’t actually be {i}you{/i}, you know?
lines.zh: : 会有那么些很长的时间段，{i}你{/i}人在这儿，也会回应，但那其实不是你，你懂吗？

lines.en: scene norikochinadress21
: Well, they’re not all {i}long{/i}, I guess. Like, this time, it was really only for a minute or two.
lines.zh: : 好吧，也不全是{i}很长{/i}。比如这次，其实也就一两分钟。

lines.en: : That just happens sometimes, I guess.
lines.zh: : 这种事偶尔就是会发生的吧。

lines.en: : {s}It could be dangerous.{/i} It’s not really something you should worry about.
lines.zh: : {s}可能会有点危险{/s}。不过你其实不用担心。

lines.en: : I never said I’m worried. If anything, I’m glad I can be here for them.
lines.zh: : 我没说我担心。反倒不如说，我很庆幸那种时候我能陪在你身边。

lines.en: : It’s a lot better knowing that you have me as an outlet to vent to if you ever want.
lines.zh: : 知道你有个可以倾诉的出口，总归要好很多。

lines.en: : Not like you {i}would{/i} ever want to do that, though, when you’ve always been pretty secretive about the things that are bothering you.
lines.zh: : 当然，你大概永远也不{i}会{/i}想那么做，毕竟你对烦心的事向来藏得很紧。

lines.en: : Like, back when we were always with Maya-
lines.zh: : 就像以前我们总和 Maya 在一起的时候——

lines.en: : Don’t talk about Maya right now.
lines.zh: : 现在别提 Maya。

lines.en: scene norikochinadress22
: I mean...fine by me. But why not?
lines.zh: : 我……随你吧。但为什么不提？

lines.en: : It’s just...not a good idea, I think.
lines.zh: : 只是……我觉得不是个好主意。

lines.en: Half of me wants to hear whatever it is Noriko has to say.
lines.zh: 一半的我想听听 Noriko 到底要说什么。

lines.en: But another half of me that I thought I’d kept at bay is now begging me to steer clear on the off chance that Maya’s thoughts are right and that...learning too much might be bad.
lines.zh: 但另一半、我以为自己早就压下去的那一半，现在却在求我绕开，万一 Maya 的想法是对的……知道得太多也许不好。

lines.en: And here I was thinking I’d be able to not take her advice.
lines.zh: 我本来还以为自己能不听她的劝。

lines.en: How annoying.
lines.zh: 真烦。

lines.en: scene norikochinadress23
: What do you want to talk about instead, then?!
lines.zh: : 那你想聊什么？！

lines.en: : I feel like tonight’s been pretty much all about me, so if there’s anything you want to say-
lines.zh: : 我觉得今晚几乎全都在聊我，所以如果你有什么想说的——

lines.en: : Keep talking about yourself.
lines.zh: : 继续聊你自己。

lines.en: : You said on Halloween that you wanted me to know more about {i}you{/i}. So tell me more about you.
lines.zh: : 万圣节那天{i}你{/i}说过想让我多了解你。那就再多跟我说说你。

lines.en: : Where do you want to go after [high_school]? What do you want to be? Just talk.
lines.zh: : 你[high_school]毕业之后想去哪儿？想做什么？随便聊聊。

lines.en: : I don’t really care what it’s about.
lines.zh: : 我真的不在乎聊什么。

lines.en: I just need something to distract me.
lines.zh: 我只是需要点东西来分散注意力。

lines.en: I need to stop slipping.
lines.zh: 我需要停止滑坡。

lines.en: I need to focus on the task at hand...getting to know Noriko and everyone else without...
lines.zh: 我需要把注意力集中在手头的事情上……去了解 Noriko 和其他所有人，不去……

lines.en: Without thinking at all.
lines.zh: 不去思考。

lines.en: I need to grind affection points.
lines.zh: 我需要刷好感度。

lines.en: Wait, what are affection points?
lines.zh: 等等，好感度是什么？

lines.en: What am I thinking?
lines.zh: 我在想什么？

lines.en: {s}Have I really spent so much time with Molly that it{/s} {b}HAVE RECENT EXPERIENCES SOMEHOW{/b} led to me treating life more like a game than I ever thought I would?
lines.zh: {s}我真的和 Molly 待了太久，久到{/s} {b}HAVE RECENT EXPERIENCES SOMEHOW{/b} 让我开始把人生当成游戏来对待了吗？

lines.en: I know those were essentially {i}my{/i} words last Halloween when-
lines.zh: 我知道那基本上就是{i}我{/i}去年万圣节说过的话，当时——

lines.en: scene samhain21
scene samhain33
scene norikochinadress23
Molly and Tsuneyo are two girls who like me and appreciate me and admire me.
lines.zh: Molly 和 Tsuneyo 是两个喜欢我、欣赏我、仰慕我的女孩。

lines.en: They will forget this the next time the world resets.
lines.zh: 等世界下一次重置，她们就会忘掉这一切。

lines.en: Ignore it and it will go away.
lines.zh: 不理它，它就会消失。

lines.en: Noriko, please break this silence.
lines.zh: Noriko，拜托打破这段沉默。

lines.en: Please.
lines.zh: 拜托。

lines.en: : I think...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……

lines.en: : That what I’d want to do more than anything is help people.
lines.zh: : 我最想做的事就是帮助别人。

lines.en: : {s}Help me{/s} How?
lines.zh: : {s}帮人{/s}？怎么帮？

lines.en: scene norikochinadress24
: I don’t know...charity work, maybe?
lines.zh: : 我不知道……也许做慈善？

lines.en: : Ideally, I’d love to do something along the lines of like...building homes for the homeless, or...teaching underprivileged kids how to read.
lines.zh: : 理想情况下，我想做一些类似……为无家可归的人盖房子，或者……教贫困的孩子读书之类的事。

lines.en: : But, unfortunately, there’s just not really any money in stuff like that.
lines.zh: : 但不幸的是，这类事情实在赚不到钱。

lines.en: : It’s really sad, you know? All the nicest, best things out there have to be done by people willing to sacrifice their well-being in order to do it.
lines.zh: : 真的很可悲，你知道吗？世上所有最美好、最善良的事，都只能由那些愿意牺牲自己生活的人去做。

lines.en: : And that’s something you’re considering?
lines.zh: : 而那是你在考虑的事？

lines.en: : I don’t really know.
lines.zh: : 我也不确定。

lines.en: : I mean, I’m in [high_school].
lines.zh: : 我是说，我还在上[high_school]。

lines.en: : Things I say right now don’t really matter. It’s what I say {i}after{/i} I graduate that matters. And anything can happen between now and then.
lines.zh: : 我现在说的话其实不算数。重要的是我毕业{i}之后{/i}说的话。而从现在到那时，什么都可能发生。

lines.en: : It would just be nice to kinda...change the world. You know?
lines.zh: : 只是，如果能稍微……改变一下世界就好了。你懂吧？

lines.en: : You’re never going to change the world.
lines.zh: : 你永远改变不了世界。

lines.en: scene norikochinadress25
: I’m not?
lines.zh: : 我改变不了？

lines.en: : {s}We’re stuck here.{/s} I highly doubt it.
lines.zh: : {s}我们被困在这里{/s}。我非常怀疑。

lines.en: : {s}Nothing can be changed.{/s} “Changing the world” is something a lot of people your age plan on doing.
lines.zh: : {s}什么都无法改变{/s}。“改变世界”是你这个年纪的很多人都打算去做的事。

lines.en: : {s}Something is buried underneath your feet.{/s} Then, once they get out of [high_school], they realize it’s impossible and fall into the same slump all people fall into.
lines.zh: : {s}有什么东西埋在你脚下{/s}。然后，等他们走出[high_school]，就会意识到那不可能，接着陷入所有人都逃不掉的颓唐。

lines.en: : {s}You will never find it.{/s} They get jobs. Go to work. Go home. Fuck whoever they’re living with. Fuck themselves if they don’t have anyone there. Sleep. And then repeat.
lines.zh: : {s}你永远找不到它{/s}。他们找工作。上班。回家。操那个和自己同居的人。要是身边没人就自己解决。睡觉。然后重复。

lines.en: : {s}It might not even exist.{/s} The world can’t be changed. There are too many people trying to prevent it from changing that it offsets all of the people who are.
lines.zh: : {s}它可能根本就不存在{/s}。世界是改变不了的。想阻止它改变的人太多，多到抵消了所有想推动它改变的人。

lines.en: : {s}Does any of this exist?{/s} If you want to waste away your life pursuing such a pipe dream, feel free. But don’t let it break your spirit when it doesn’t pan out how you want.
lines.zh: : {s}这些真的存在吗{/s}？如果你想把一生浪费在追逐这种白日梦上，请便。只是别在它没有如你所愿实现时，把自己的心气儿给折了。

lines.en: : Are you sure your memories are broken?
lines.zh: : 你确定你的记忆坏掉了吗？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : It’s just that you said essentially the same exact thing to me when I was little.
lines.zh: : 只是你在我小时候对我说过几乎一模一样的话。

lines.en: : Which, at the time, was pretty upsetting since I was still just a kid.
lines.zh: : 那时候还挺让人难受的，因为我当时还只是个孩子。

lines.en: : But hey, it prepared me for {i}not{/i} getting upset this time around, so at least that’s good.
lines.zh: : 不过嘿，正因为这样，这次我早就做好了{i}不难过{/i}的准备，所以至少这点挺好。

lines.en: : Have we really had this discussion before?
lines.zh: : 我们以前真的聊过这个吗？

lines.en: : More or less. Just, minus the whole “[high_school]” part of it.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧。只是少了“[high_school]”那部分。

lines.en: : Well...at the end of the day, you’re still just a [teenager]. Any “difference” you could make wouldn’t happen until you’re much older.
lines.zh: : 好吧……说到底，你还只是个[teenager]。你能带来的任何“改变”，都得等到你再大很多之后。

lines.en: scene norikochinadress26
: I mean...yeah. But is that {i}really{/i} all I am? Because my time with you has made me feel like I’m a little bit more than that.
lines.zh: : 我是说……是啊。但我{i}真的{/i}就只有这些吗？因为和你相处的这段时间，让我觉得自己不止于此。

lines.en: : The time I do remember? Or the time I don’t? Because I don’t really think I’ve done anything substantial since you walked back into my life.
lines.zh: : 你记得的那段？还是不记得的那段？因为我真不觉得你回到我生活里之后，我做过什么有意义的事。

lines.en: : Before.
lines.zh: : 是之前。

lines.en: : You were no normal tutor, Sensei. Like, sure you helped us with our general studies and reading comprehension and all that...
lines.zh: : 你从来都不是个普通的家教，老师。当然，你确实帮我们补习了那些普通科目和阅读理解什么的……

lines.en: : But a lot of the things you taught us were those same cynical spiels about how the world will never change or how...time is a bitch...
lines.zh: : 但你教给我们的很多东西，都是那些关于世界永远不会改变、或者……时间是个婊子之类的愤世嫉俗的长篇大论……

lines.en: : And all this other stuff most girls would get weirded out by.
lines.zh: : 还有一堆大多数女孩听了都会觉得别扭的东西。

lines.en: : We loved you, though. So we listened.
lines.zh: : 可我们爱你。所以我们听着。

lines.en: : We ate up every word and, soon enough, we started to echo those feelings.
lines.zh: : 我们把你说的每一个字都吞了下去，没过多久，我们就开始附和那些感受。

lines.en: : But the interesting thing about feelings is that they don’t work the same way in all people.
lines.zh: : 但感受有意思的地方在于，它们在不同人身上的运作方式并不相同。

lines.en: : And once they’re inside of you, they evolve and adapt in ways that make them much more than echoes. They’re closer to like...screams or...encryption keys or something.
lines.zh: : 一旦进了你的身体，它们就会进化、会适应，变得远远不只是回声。它们更接近于……尖叫，或者……加密密钥之类的东西。

lines.en: : But {i}you{/i} were the one that helped us realize we were more than just average girls.
lines.zh: : 但让我们意识到自己不只是普通女孩的人，是{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : My decision to go down the path of finding my own sense of...individuality was a lot more than just wanting to detach myself from Nee-chan.
lines.zh: : 我选择走上寻找自己……所谓“个性”的这条路，远不止是为了和姐姐撇清关系。

lines.en: : It was me doing something I thought would make you proud.
lines.zh: : 那是我做的一件自以为能让你骄傲的事。

lines.en: : It was me turning into a person that wouldn’t ever fit into one of those cynical analogies you’d tell some other [young_girl], still naive to the world around her.
lines.zh: : 那是我变成一个、永远塞不进你讲给某个[young_girl]听的、那些愤世嫉俗的比喻里的人的过程——那个女孩对周遭的世界还一无所知。

lines.en: : It was me following in your footsteps, even when I had no idea where they were, what they looked like, or where they were heading.
lines.zh: : 那是我踩着你的脚印往前走，哪怕我根本不知道那脚印在哪儿、长什么样、通向何方。

lines.en: : Like it or not, you were always my role model. And you’ll probably always {i}be{/i} my role model.
lines.zh: : 不管你愿不愿意，你一直是我的榜样。而且大概永远都{i}会{/i}是我的榜样。

lines.en: scene norikochinadress27
: Even when you think you’re the worst human being in the world...that you’re absolute shit...something I {i}know{/i} you feel sometimes...
lines.zh: : 哪怕你觉得自己是全世界最糟糕的人……觉得自己是彻头彻尾的废物……我{i}知道{/i}你有时会有这种感觉……

lines.en: : Even then, I will be here to remind you that you are more than that.
lines.zh: : 即便如此，我也会在这里提醒你，你远不止于此。

lines.en: : Underneath all of that pain and anguish and...defeat is the man who single handedly turned me into the girl I am today.
lines.zh: : 在那些痛苦、煎熬和……挫败之下，是那个单凭一己之力把我塑造成今天的我的男人。

lines.en: : Maya, too. She {i}definitely{/i} wouldn’t be who she is if it wasn’t for you.
lines.zh: : Maya 也是。如果没有你，她{i}绝{/i}不会是现在的她。

lines.en: scene norikochinadress28
: But that’s why I haven’t {i}entirely{/i} given up on changing the world yet.
lines.zh: : 但正因如此，我还没有{i}彻底{/i}放弃改变世界的念头。

lines.en: : If {i}you{/i} weren’t able to, maybe it’ll make you feel a little better if I can.
lines.zh: : 如果{i}你{/i}没能做到，也许我能做到的话，会让你好受一点。

lines.en: : Or, at the very least, show you that you left some sort of positive mark on the world instead of just some giant shadow...
lines.zh: : 或者，至少让你看到，你在这世上留下的不只是巨大的阴影，还有某种积极的东西……

lines.en: scene norikochinadress29
: So! What’s the plan for Christmas?
lines.zh: : 好啦！圣诞节有什么打算？

lines.en: : Wanna go on a date?
lines.zh: : 想去约会吗？

lines.en: : I know this one bakery that has {i}amazing{/i} cakes throughout all of December.
lines.zh: : 我知道有家面包店整个十二月都有{i}特别棒{/i}的蛋糕。

lines.en: : You’re just...moving right on to the next topic?
lines.zh: : 你就这么……直接跳到下一个话题了？

lines.en: : Instead of what? Making you feel even more uncomfortable by tangentially detailing all of the reasons I still love you after all these years? Of course.
lines.zh: : 不然呢？拐弯抹角地细数这么多年过去我依然爱你的理由，把你弄得更不自在吗？当然不。

lines.en: : We’ve reached the part of the conversation where I attempt to get closer to you through future plans instead of past occurrences. And Christmas is the most romantic day of the year.
lines.zh: : 我们的对话已经到了这个阶段：我要用未来的计划、而不是过去的往事来靠近你。而圣诞节是一年里最浪漫的日子。

lines.en: scene norikochinadress30
: I’m pretty sure the class will wind up having another party.
lines.zh: : 班上多半又会办一场派对。

lines.en: : That’s what happened last year and I never really got a say in it.
lines.zh: : 去年就是那样，而且我从来没真正有发言权。

lines.en: : Are we getting each other presents?
lines.zh: : 我们要互送礼物吗？

lines.en: : They did a Secret Santa thing last time, so I imagine they’ll do that again as well.
lines.zh: : 上次他们搞了秘密圣诞老人，我想这次大概也会。

lines.en: : I’m not talking about that. I’m talking about you and me.
lines.zh: : 我不是说那个。我是说你和我。

lines.en: scene norikochinadress31
: There’s something I want to give you.
lines.zh: : 有样东西我想给你。

lines.en: : I’m not sure if you’ll {i}like{/i} it...but I found it when I was digging through some old stuff recently...and I think you should have it.
lines.zh: : 我不确定你会不会{i}喜欢{/i}……但我最近翻旧东西的时候找到了它……我觉得应该归你。

lines.en: : And...you don’t {i}have{/i} to get me anything in return, but...
lines.zh: : 而且……你{i}不用{/i}回送我什么，但是……

lines.en: : But it would make me really happy if you did...
lines.zh: : 但如果你送了，我会非常非常开心……

lines.en: : Forget-
lines.zh: : 忘掉——

lines.en: : Sure.
scene norikochinadress32
: Ah-
: I’m sure I can manage to remember that much.
lines.zh: : 这点我总该记得住。

lines.en: : At least I know about this present beforehand, unlike last year.
lines.zh: : 至少这次我提前知道有这份礼物了，不像去年。

lines.en: scene norikochinadress33
: Mmn~
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯~

lines.en: : Is everything okay?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？

lines.en: : I got weirdly turned on by the idea of you buying me a Christmas present and now I’m trying to stay cool.
lines.zh: : 一想到你会给我买圣诞礼物，我就莫名地来劲了，现在正努力装作没事。

lines.en: : It's a shock thing. I don't know. I get horny when things surprise me sometimes.
lines.zh: : 就是那种被惊到的反应。我也不知道。有时候被出其不意地吓一下，我就会发情。

lines.en: : Do you...
: Do you want me to go find you a desk or something?
lines.zh: : 要我去给你找张桌子之类的吗？

lines.en: scene norikochinadress34
: You’re really going to make me regret telling you that desk thing, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你真的会让我后悔告诉你桌子那件事的，对吧？

lines.en: scene black
As Noriko would say, “the horny” fades away and I wind up leaving shortly after that.
lines.zh: 用 Noriko 的话说，“那股色心”褪去了，没过多久我便起身离开。

lines.en: And, I don’t know why...but I’m actually kind of thankful that nothing else wound up happening.
lines.zh: 而我不知道为什么……我其实还挺庆幸最后什么都没发生。

lines.en: In fact, I might even feel a little...better?
lines.zh: 事实上，我甚至觉得有点……好些了？

lines.en: Not better in the fact that I feel {i}good{/i}...but better in the fact that some of the clouds inside of my head have begun to clear up.
lines.zh: 不是说身体上觉得{i}好{/i}——而是说我脑子里那些云雾开始散开了一点。

lines.en: I’m sure tomorrow will be overcast as well- it always is.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定明天依然会是阴天——反正一直是。

lines.en: But it was nice being reminded of what it feels like to see a little clearer, even if it’s only for a short while...
lines.zh: 但能重新体会一下看得稍微清楚些是什么感觉，哪怕只是很短的一会儿，也挺好的……

lines.en: $ noriko_love += 1
$ norikodorm20 = True
{i}Noriko’s affection has increased to [noriko_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Noriko 的好感度提升到了 [noriko_love]!{/i}

lines.en: The clouds come back on the way home.
lines.zh: 回家的路上，云又回来了。

lines.en: They feel a little like hands.
lines.zh: 它们摸起来有点像手。
